svg.text: PROJECT 1 · DISTILLED-JUDGE VALIDITY TRANSFER · SEALED CHAIN v1→v4
The copy kept the answers. It did not keep the validity.

g.text: PURPOSE
Does a copy of a validated judge keep the validity — or only
the answers? One copy, taken back to the world.
TRAINING PAIRS — one per respondent × party
input: the respondent’s own words — ANES open-ended answers to
“What do you like / dislike about the [Democratic / Republican]
party?” — temporal text spanning 1984–2020
target: the 0–100 affect score GPT-4 assigned that answer in 2023
9,857 pairs · split by respondent: 7,914 train · 935 val · 1,008 test
STUDENTS & ENGINE
Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct · Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (revision-pinned)
LoRA rank {8,16,32} × lr {1e-4, 2e-4}, bf16 · PyTorch + PEFT,
A100s via SLURM · teacher-verbatim prompts & exemplars ·
temperature 0 · the teacher’s own output parser, unmodified
DISCIPLINE
prereg sealed before training · selection blind to the criterion ·
students frozen, then one criterion read — struck (scrambled
column, caught by audit), re-run on the CDF-verified criterion (v4)

svg.text: Every artifact hashed; every verdict mechanical; one strike on the record.
THE FINDINGS · v4, VERIFIED CRITERION, 1,002 UNITS
Slope against the world (held-out thermometers, identical units)

g.text: teacher
Qwen copy
Mistral copy

svg.text: the certificate read 0.74 for both copies — and flagged nothing

g.text: VERDICTS, MECHANICAL
H1 — validity transfer: FALSIFIED, downward (−0.15 both
students; both sealed clauses fired; families agree to 3 decimals)
H3 — party invariance: FALSIFIED — copies acquired a party
asymmetry the teacher never had (gap 0.23 / 0.19 vs 0.02)
H2 — fidelity 0.74: mid-band; dissociation unavailable, as sealed
Reliability: 0 parse failures in ~24,000 generations
Teacher: replicated out-of-sample, under seal (0.71; published 0.75)

svg.text: Statistics: OLS slope + Pearson r, cluster bootstrap over respondents,
2,000 replicates, seed 42 · tolerances sealed before any result existed
The certificate said both copies were fine. The world said they lost a fifth of the slope and gained a bias. Agreement flagged neither.
All numbers manifest-verified · chain v1→v4, hashes on the record · interpretation of mechanism deliberately withheld pending Project 2
